h1: Custom Recycled Pullovers for Eco-Conscious Branding
metaDescription: Shop custom recycled pullovers at Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly branding for your team or event. Bulk orders available.
introHtml: Recycled pullovers offer the same comfort and durability as traditional fleece, but with a lower environmental footprint. Made from post-consumer or post-industrial recycled polyester, these garments appeal to eco-conscious employees and customers. Whether you choose a full-zip hoodie from Hanes or a quarter-zip from Eco-Logic, each piece can be custom embroidered or screen printed with your logo. Ideal for corporate uniforms, trade shows, or sustainability-focused giveaways.
heroAltText: Custom recycled pullovers in heather gray with company logo embroidered on chest
